name: day17-microservices
description: Day 17 lecture: the same store as ../monolith, split into a gateway + 8 services

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build --wait
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names gateway,users,catalog,inventory,cart,orders,payments,notify --prefix-colors auto "npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w services/users" "npm run dev -w services/catalog" "npm run dev -w services/inventory" "npm run dev -w services/cart" "npm run dev -w services/orders" "npm run dev -w services/payments" "npm run dev -w services/notifications"
